'''Quantum mechanics''' is one framework to the study of [[mechanics]]. Developed in the late 19th and 20th century, it describes more accurately the behaviour of sub-atomic scale [[physical system]]s than [[classical mechanics]], such as the [[wave-particle duality of light]].

== Key postulates ==

See [[postulates of quantum mechanics]].

It provides a more accurate description of the behaviour of subatomic-scale particles than [[classical mechanics]].
